shared_elements: human figures in relief, shown in profile
figures in contact with / handling animals
horizontal frieze-like row of figures across the surface
justification: Both surfaces show a horizontal band of human figures in low relief together with quadruped animals, and in both some figures reach toward or handle an animal, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is an orderly, evenly spaced procession of tall, elongated, naturalistically detailed attendants leading a single humped animal, framed above and below by rosette borders, whereas B is a crowded, overlapping cluster of squat, thick-limbed figures in agitated postures with no framing register or ornamental band.
